## Independent re-verification at a later HEAD (18f08d57c06)

Re-checked the landed guard on a fresh worktree of current origin/main — 13 commits past
the merge — to confirm it has not re-rotted and that it genuinely has teeth per module.

PER-MODULE MUTATION MATRIX (new evidence; the prior close note proved the aggregate only).
Appended a real uncapped `self._client.search_issues(f"project = {k}")` to EACH of the 11
modules in adapters/jira_datacenter/ one at a time and ran
test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size. All 11 went RED, each naming
the offending file:line —
  __init__.py:32  _base.py:200  _hierarchy.py:212  _issues.py:313  _links.py:114
  _people.py:181  backend.py:445  retry.py:262  settings.py:129  transitions.py:170
  transport.py:241
No module is blind. Tree restored clean after each.

ANTI-VACUITY MUTATIONS (both directions of the rot).
1. Re-pin the scan to transport.py only (the exact 34c2 root cause) -> 2 failed, 21 passed:
   'the pagination guard never scans [_base.py, _issues.py]' and 'stripping every explicit
   cap from the DC adapter sources produced NO offenders'.
2. Rename search_issues out of _base.py and _issues.py so the package holds ZERO call sites
   -> RED with 'no module in the DC adapter contains a search_issues call at all — either
   the package moved (fix _DC_ADAPTER_DIR) or this whole guard is now unnecessary'.
   This is the criterion that matters: zero call sites FAILS loudly rather than passing.

GATES on the merged tree: module 23 passed; make lint exit 0; make typecheck exit 0
(mypy, 432 source files); CI's real selection
`pytest -m 'not integration and not external' -n 4 --dist worksteal` -> 10216 passed,
46 skipped, 1 error. The single error is
test_plan_review_resign.py::test_public_resign_preserves_mixed_child_scope_and_validity
('Test leaked new entries into REPO_ROOT') — it PASSES in isolation, is in an unrelated
subsystem, and is a parallel-execution isolation artifact, not a 34c2 regression.

18a4 interaction: the landed commit aa3cf27102 touches zero lines mentioning
BackendPaginationStallError; the 9 stall-error references and their 5 tests are intact and
green. Neither duplicated nor weakened.

No code changed by this verification pass.
